scope.question: On the six actual Phase-53 source-by-lambda launch states, does the historical Phase-51 global non-CSE active lambda-blended gradient or completed RHS fail the frozen direct-global 120-decimal accuracy gate, and does a frozen global-versus-element-local by standard-versus-long within-callable 2-by-2 audit localize the arithmetic mechanism without replaying continuation?
computed: static stage-by-stage gradient and completed-RHS comparisons for a core four-cell evaluator matrix and two contextual controls at exactly six Phase-53 launch states
independent direct global SymPy/mpmath references at 80 and 120 decimal digits
raw m4 gradient, lifted m4 gradient, raw m5 gradient, lambda blend, ordinary A_lambda transpose contraction, and one outer minus-conjugation
controlled 2-by-2 differences, fixed vector-difference telescopes, and absolute, relative, raw-dtype, and canonical-digest ledgers
not_computed: any saddle, Gamma--K root, nonlinear flow ODE, trajectory fraction, continuation, reflection, finite-difference, tangent, endpoint, action, first-cap, orientation, or topology replay
a Phase-51 or Phase-53 continuation reclassification or a rewrite of any historical result
other states, sources, lambdas, roots, charts, arms, cap reintersections, components, ends, cutoff or continuum limits, global cycles, physics, or TOE claims
scope.historical_boundary: Phase 51 remains immutable and its all-temporaries-clongdouble protocol remains NOT_UPHELD. Phase 53 remains a separate VALID_RUN with an inconclusive local classification. Phase 54 audits only the arithmetic accuracy role of the saved Phase-51 global non-CSE control on six static states.

disclosed_prior_evidence.Phase52: The static element-local evaluator passed its six-slot direct 120-decimal gradient/RHS gates; the long-namespace joint-CSE accuracy control did not.
disclosed_prior_evidence.Phase53: The coherent element-local production evaluator passed the independent six-slot 80/120-decimal full reference, while the inherited saved Phase-51 global non-CSE paired-evaluator RHS gate remained non-passing.
disclosed_prior_evidence.role: These are disclosed prior results. They motivate the audit but do not alter its frozen thresholds or permit slot, stage, evaluator, or output selection.

pin_validation.strict_parse: Reject duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, overflow-to-nonfinite numbers, schema drift, self-digest drift, and any working-byte or named commit-blob mismatch before evaluation.
pin_validation.transitive_consistency: Flatten the Phase-52 and Phase-53 declarations of their Phase-51/41/42/49/50 and lockfile inputs and require byte-identical agreement wherever the same path is declared.
pin_validation.ordering: The bound Phase-54 manifest commit must predate and be an ancestor of every Phase-54 runner or result commit.
pin_validation.post_rehash: Rehash this manifest, the future committed runner, and all six pinned artifacts after evaluation.
pin_validation.volatile_identity_policy: Process-local Python id(...) integers serialized by Phase 53 are pinned historical bytes but are not Phase-54 callable identity evidence. Phase 54 must use source hashes, generated DAG fingerprints, and explicit role labels and must not serialize a native id(...) as a stable cross-process identifier.

slots.state_policy: Consume the dtype-explicit complex256 decimal pairs from the pinned Phase-53 result. Do not re-solve, copy a Phase-50 cache, or substitute a nearby state.
slots.state_digest_algorithm: SHA256 of json.dumps(input_state_w5, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8') after strict parsing.

stage_contract.state_map: With the pinned source evaluator, c=inverse_basis_long@(w5-anchor5) and w4=anchor4+c[:7].
prohibited: a second or omitted outer conjugation
complex128 projection before a complete native outer RHS exists
stage reordering, expansion retuning, favorable summation order, or post-output slot exclusion

GN_std.construction: Invoke the actual saved pinned Phase-51 LongCallableSet.evaluate(..., plain=True) path and its joint_plain global gradient-plus-Hessian lambdify callable with cse=False; use only the returned gradient slice. Instrument the exact saved joint_plain return to retain its raw tuple and dtypes before the declared LongCallableSet np.asarray(..., dtype=clongdouble) wrapper boundary, and require the captured post-boundary gradient to equal the historical evaluate output. A newly lambdified gradient-only look-alike is not this historical control.
GN_std.role: historical control under audit and standard/global core cell

GN_long.construction: Use the exact same pinned unreduced joint gradient-plus-Hessian expression tuple, output order, argument order, input states, cse=False schedule, gradient slice, and declared post-call clongdouble wrapper boundary as GN_std, but compile the joint tuple with the pinned Phase-52 LongNumPyPrinter and LONG_MODULES. Every generated literal, function boundary, raw scalar, and runtime dtype is audited; no element split, output-arity change, or CSE replacement is allowed.
GN_long.role: long/global core cell isolating namespace, literal, and arithmetic precision from decomposition

EL_std.construction: Reuse the exact Phase-53 source-substituted per-element canonical gradient CSE plans, element order, replacement DAGs, and back-substitution identities, but compile and evaluate each element with the standard SymPy NumPy printer/modules and without LongNumPyPrinter or LONG_MODULES. Record every raw temporary and contribution before coercion, cast each complete contribution only at the declared complex128 accumulator boundary, then sum componentwise in the exact fixed left-to-right element order with complex128 arithmetic. Record that complete raw gradient and dtype before the common clongdouble stage-boundary cast. A changed element DAG/order or undeclared coercion is forbidden.
EL_std.symbolic_plan_binding: Before printer rendering, require ordered element expressions, canonical replacements, reduced outputs, replacement counts, dummy-normalized DAGs, and exact back-substitution to equal EL_long. Compute and retain distinct standard generated-source hashes; the long generated-source projection digest is not falsely reused as an EL_std source digest.
EL_std.role: standard/element-local core cell; element decomposition/order is held fixed while callable and accumulator precision differ from EL_long

EL_long.construction: The pinned Phase-53 source-substituted per-element gradient CSE plans with fixed left-to-right clongdouble accumulation.
EL_long.role: exact Phase-53 production evaluator and long/element-local core cell

phase51_global_CSE_context.construction: The actual pinned Phase-51 global joint gradient-plus-Hessian canonical CSE callable; use only its gradient slice and preserve its standard NumPy native arithmetic.
phase51_global_CSE_context.role: contextual historical production control outside the core matrix

phase52_long_namespace_joint_CSE_context.construction: The pinned Phase-52 LongNumPyPrinter/LONG_MODULES version of the same global joint CSE DAG with clongdouble literals, functions, temporaries, and raw outputs.
phase52_long_namespace_joint_CSE_context.role: contextual typed global joint-CSE control outside the core matrix

controlled_contrasts: GN_std -> GN_long: change only standard versus long printer/modules inside the same unreduced global non-CSE joint gradient-plus-Hessian tuple; output arity/order, gradient slice, declared wrapper cast, and downstream stages are identical

EL_std -> EL_long: change only standard-complex128 versus long-clongdouble callable and accumulator arithmetic inside the same per-element CSE DAGs and fixed element order; the raw summed gradient is recorded before the common boundary cast and downstream stages are identical
GN_std -> EL_std: change only global non-CSE versus element-local CSE/fixed-sum decomposition under the standard namespace
GN_long -> EL_long: change only global non-CSE versus element-local CSE/fixed-sum decomposition under the long namespace
evaluators.common_post_callable_boundary: For every native evaluator, first retain the complete pre-downstream m4 and m5 gradient vectors and their true dtypes. For GN_std, GN_long, and the joint-CSE controls, also retain the entire ordered raw joint tuple before applying the exact declared LongCallableSet clongdouble wrapper and gradient slice. For EL_std and EL_long, retain every contribution and the complete fixed-order summed gradient before casting that complete gradient to clongdouble when needed. The resulting stage-ready gradient must equal the declared historical or production path. From that single declared boundary onward use the same pinned inverse-basis lift, lambda blend, ordinary factor transpose, and one outer minus-conjugation in fixed clongdouble arithmetic; no duplicate cast may be counted as evidence.
evaluators.binding_policy: Bind every implementation by pinned source, generated source/DAG hash, back-substitution identity, callable role, output arity/order, and audited raw dtype. The four core cells must differ only along their declared row or column; a reimplemented look-alike, hash-only relabel, coercion before raw recording, undeclared additional or dtype-hiding coercion, omitted declared boundary cast, or hidden schedule change is INVALID_RUN.

expression_sources.m4: The source-substituted global gradient from pinned phase41.numeric_model(delta_a, delta_phi).
expression_sources.m5: The source-substituted global gradient from pinned phase50.m5_numeric_model(delta_a, delta_phi).

reference.backend: Evaluate unreduced global expressions directly with SymPy evalf at the active precision and perform the lift, blend, ordinary transpose contraction, and outer minus-conjugation only with mpmath mp.mpf/mp.mpc algebra.
reference.input_lift: Construct mp.mpc values directly from the pinned complex256 decimal pairs; reconstruct native clongdouble values from the same pairs and require exact decimal round-trip.
reference.symbolic_CSE_control: At both precision tiers evaluate the canonical symbolic replacement DAG with SymPy substitutions and compare it to the unreduced direct expression. Neither path may call NumPy lambdify or consume a native evaluator output.
reference.independence_boundary: The direct reference independently checks arithmetic for the same finite symbolic model; it is not an independent physical model or a physics validation.

metrics_and_thresholds.retained_absolute: Retain normwise and maximum-component absolute differences at every slot, evaluator, and stage.

activity_policy.m4_raw_gradient_and_lifted: active only when 1-lambda is nonzero; at lambda=1 retain them as inactive diagnostics
activity_policy.m5_raw_gradient: active only when lambda is nonzero; at lambda=0 retain it as an inactive diagnostic
activity_policy.classification_selector_policy: Only GN_std records at the two selector stages confirm or fail to confirm the historical-control accuracy nonpass. GN_long and EL_std select only the detailed attribution after GN_std nonpass is confirmed; EL_long must pass both selector stages or the run is INVALID_RUN. Raw, lifted, and contraction stages remain first-nonpass diagnostics only.

metrics_and_thresholds.telescope_identity: For each chain, slot, and stage require (left-middle)+(middle-reference)-(left-reference) to close under the frozen relative tolerance.
metrics_and_thresholds.threshold_policy: All thresholds are copied unchanged from the pinned Phase-51/52 contracts. No Phase-53 or Phase-54 observed value may weaken them.

classification.scientific_classification_prerequisite: Every scientific label requires a valid and complete run, both 80/120 and symbolic-CSE reference gates, all five-chain 5e-18 telescope closures, all 6-by-2 selector records for each core evaluator, exact topology, and every global null guard to pass.

invalid_run.label: INVALID_RUN
invalid_run.if: Any byte pin, commit blob, self-digest, strict JSON, runtime, slot digest, evaluator binding, stage identity/order/dimension, direct-reference independence, 80/120 reference-stability gate, symbolic-CSE reference-stability gate, telescope completeness or 5e-18 closure, topology, provenance, or null-boundary prerequisite fails, or EL_long exceeds the direct-120 threshold at either selector stage on any slot.

historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.label: P51_GLOBAL_NONCSE_ACTIVE_GRADIENT_RHS_NONPASS_CONFIRMED_LONG_PRECISION_ONLY_SUFFICIENT_ON_PHASE53_SIX_SLOTS
historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.if: GN_std exceeds the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 threshold at either selector stage on at least one slot, EL_long passes both selector stages on all slots, GN_long passes both selector stages on all slots, and EL_std does not.

historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.label: P51_GLOBAL_NONCSE_ACTIVE_GRADIENT_RHS_NONPASS_CONFIRMED_ELEMENT_LOCAL_SCHEDULE_ONLY_SUFFICIENT_ON_PHASE53_SIX_SLOTS
historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.if: GN_std exceeds the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 threshold at either selector stage on at least one slot, EL_long passes both selector stages on all slots, EL_std passes both selector stages on all slots, and GN_long does not.

historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.label: P51_GLOBAL_NONCSE_ACTIVE_GRADIENT_RHS_NONPASS_CONFIRMED_BOTH_LONG_PRECISION_AND_ELEMENT_LOCAL_SCHEDULE_INDEPENDENTLY_SUFFICIENT_ON_PHASE53_SIX_SLOTS
historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.if: GN_std exceeds the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 threshold at either selector stage on at least one slot, EL_long, GN_long, and EL_std each pass both selector stages on all slots.

historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.label: P51_GLOBAL_NONCSE_ACTIVE_GRADIENT_RHS_NONPASS_CONFIRMED_PRECISION_X_SCHEDULE_INTERACTION_REQUIRED_ON_PHASE53_SIX_SLOTS
historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_conf.if: GN_std exceeds the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 threshold at either selector stage on at least one slot, EL_long passes both selector stages on all slots, and neither GN_long nor EL_std passes both selector stages on all slots.

historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_not_.label: P51_GLOBAL_NONCSE_ACTIVE_GRADIENT_RHS_ACCURACY_NONPASS_NOT_CONFIRMED_ON_PHASE53_SIX_SLOTS
historical_control_accuracy_nonpass_not_.if: The run is valid and complete, both reference-stability gates and all telescope gates pass, EL_long passes both selector stages on all slots, and GN_std stays at or below the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 thresholds at both selector stages on all six slots. GN_long and EL_std remain diagnostic in this branch.

classification.selector_pass_definition: An evaluator passes a selector only if every one of its 6 slots by 2 selector-stage comparisons is at or below the mapped 5e-10 direct-120 threshold. Equality passes. Contextual controls never select a label.
classification.other_stage_and_evaluator_results_role: Record all values and PASS/NONPASS statuses, including inactive endpoint branches and the first diagnostic stage of divergence, but raw, lifted, contraction, and contextual-control records do not select any label or broader repair, continuation, or physical classification.

runtime_contract.policy: Any runtime or required thread-environment drift is INVALID_RUN; retain observable BLAS/LAPACK backend configuration.

run_semantics.pre_authoritative_mode: A future --validate-only mode may parse pins, verify committed blobs, bind expressions/evaluators, and check topology without evaluating numerical slots.
run_semantics.authoritative_mode: Only a runner commit descending from the later bound manifest commit may emit a result. Evaluate all predeclared slots, variants, stages, reference tiers, and telescopes and retain every failure.
